name: Pre-Boss
desc: Start as you normally would — build a couple of houses and increase your maximum health and mana. If you have a Gravitation Potion , search for floating islands and Planetoids .

notes: * This is difficult to obtain. Squirrel Squire Staff Held weapons: Leather Whip

name: Pre- Eater of Worlds / Brain of Cthulhu
desc: Defeating your first bosses vastly expands your options: After the Eye of Cthulhu is defeated, you should explore the Underground Jungle , fight the Blood Moon and Goblin Army , and challenge the newly unlocked Acid Rain event. Defeating the Desert Scourge unlocks the Giant Clam miniboss and is the point where you should explore the Sunken Sea . Crabulon can also be fought for weapons and the Mushroom Plasma Root power-up. Lastly, maxing out your health and mana will help you prepare for your first major step in progression.

name: Pre- Wall of Flesh
desc: With Skeletron defeated, you should explore the dungeon then head to the Abyss and loot its newly unlocked Ancient Treasure Chests . Down in the Underworld, Shadow Chests can now be opened, and you should now explore the Brimstone Crags . Once ready, you can fight The Slime God , who is an optional boss which drops useful items as well as the Electrolyte Gel Pack power-up. Additionally, you can now use Blood Orbs at an Alchemy Table to make most available potions , including some traditionally Hardmode -exclusive ones, such as Lifeforce Potions . When you are prepared, defeat the Wall of Flesh

name: Pre- Mechanical Bosses
desc: Entering Hardmode greatly expands the potential equipment options for every class. Life Fruits become available immediately, and you can craft a Comet Shard to increase your maximum mana. You can defeat Queen Slime or Cryogen for weapons and armor. There are several changes to the world: the Astral Infection and Hallow will appear, while the Sunken Sea and Brimstone Crag now feature tougher enemies and new loot. A powerful new hook, the Serpent's Bite , can now be obtained. The Calamity Mod also adds a config option to rework early Hardmode progression. This guide will assume that that option

name: Post- Mechanical Boss 1
desc: After defeating your first Mechanical Boss , you will have access to the second tier of Hardmode Ore and the Hardmode Anvils . You will also be able to mine Infernal Suevite at the Brimstone Crag . After grabbing the improved gear available at this tier, it is recommended you fight the Aquatic Scourge at the Sulphurous Sea to unlock the second tier of the Acid Rain event. The Solar Eclipse can now randomly appear, offering useful weapons and accessories as well as the Bat Hook , dropped by Vampires . This should prepare you for the next Mechanical Boss fight.

name: Post- Mechanical Boss 2
desc: With your second Mechanical Boss defeated, you should now have access to the third tier of Hardmode Ore. You can now mine Cryonic Ore in the Ice biome if you have defeated Cryogen. The Brimstone Elemental can be challenged for some weapons. All of these items should allow you to face your final Mechanical Boss.

name: Pre- Plantera
desc: After killing the final Mechanical Bosses, you now have access to Hallowed Bars and Chlorophyte Bars . If you find yourself short on Hallowed Bars, Hallowed Ore will also have generated in the Underground Hallow . The Sanguine Tangerine can now be crafted to increase your maximum HP beyond what is obtainable from Life Fruit. The Calamitas Clone can be fought for new gear and for Solar Veils , dropped during the Solar Eclipse. Once ready, it's time to take on Plantera .

name: Pre- Golem
desc: With Plantera defeated, Perennial Ore spawns. Enemies in the Dungeon become much stronger and begin dropping Ectoplasm . Sandstorms can spawn the Great Sand Shark , offering weapons and a new crafting material. You should fight Leviathan and Anahita and Astrum Aureus at this stage, with the former unlocking new crafting materials in the Abyss and the latter offering many new weapons from Astral Infection enemies as well as the Starlight Fuel Cell power-up. The Solar Eclipse now has new enemies that drop new weapons. When you're prepared, enter the Jungle Temple and challenge Golem .

name: Post- Golem
desc: Defeating Golem gives you access to Scoria Ore in the third layer of the Abyss, and Plague enemies will begin spawning in the Jungle . Make sure to consume a Miracle Fruit to increase your maximum HP. You can also take on the Martian Invasion , the final stage of the Old One's Army , and the two event moons: the Frost Moon and the Pumpkin Moon .

name: Pre- Lunar Events
desc: Using the new equipment from the previously mentioned events and environments, you should take on some of the more difficult Hardmode bosses: the Plaguebringer Goliath , the Empress of Light , Duke Fishron , and Ravager . Their drops will prepare you for your penultimate challenges, the Lunatic Cultist and the Lunar Events .

name: Pre- Moon Lord
desc: With the Lunatic Cultist defeated, you now have the Ancient Manipulator . After defeating a couple of the pillars and crafting new gear with Meld Constructs and Lunar Fragments , you can take on your second-to-last Hardmode boss: Astrum Deus , who unlocks Astral Bars . All of this grants you access to many new accessories and weapons, as well as the Ethereal Core to boost your maximum mana. The Lunar Hook , the best hook from now until halfway through Post-Moon Lord, can now be obtained. With this, you should be fully prepared to take on the final boss of Hardmode, the Moon Lord .

name: Pre- Providence
desc: The story of Calamity continues after defeating the Moon Lord. You can now craft new gear using Luminite Bars and Lunar Fragments . The next bosses to fight are Dragonfolly , who offers some weapons and an accessory, and the Profaned Guardians , who drop the Profaned Core needed to summon Providence .

name: Pre- Polterghast
desc: Defeating Providence gives you access to new crafting materials: Divine Geodes and Uelibloom Ore , which allow you to craft Tarragon armor and stronger weapons. The Tainted Cloudberry can now be crafted to increase your maximum HP. Both Ravager and the enemies in the Brimstone Crag will start dropping Bloodstone , another valuable material. Additionally, Providence drops the Mark of Providence , allowing you to fight three new bosses, each of which offer opportunities for new equipment to ready you to face Polterghast .

name: Pre- Devourer of Gods
desc: Polterghast 's defeat gives you Ruinous Souls , allowing you to craft Bloodflare armor and more gear. The Phantom Heart , the final mana upgrade, is now available. The third tier of the Acid Rain event has now been unlocked, and The Old Duke can be challenged for powerful weapons. Lastly, you should explore the fourth layer of the Abyss , as its minibosses will begin dropping new, powerful items, such as the exceptionally quick Bobbit Hook , which is the final and best hook in the game. All of this gear put together will prepare you for your next big challenge: defeating the Devourer of Gods .

name: Pre- Yharon
desc: Slaying The Devourer of Gods grants you Cosmilite Bars . Three new crafting materials are now available from buffed enemies: Darksun Fragments from the Solar Eclipse , Endothermic Energy from the Frost Moon , and Nightmare Fuel from the Pumpkin Moon . These can be combined with Necroplasm to create Ascendant Spirit Essence . The Cosmic Anvil is the key to your next set of powerful items. When all is said and done, it is time to challenge Yharon .

name: Pre- Exo Mechs / Supreme Witch, Calamitas
desc: Defeating Yharon causes Auric Ore to generate underground . Combining them with the Yharon Soul Fragments dropped by the boss allows you to craft Auric Tesla armor and powerful Auric weapons. You should also craft the Sacred Strawberry , the final HP upgrade. Finally, it is time to challenge the Exo Mechs and Supreme Witch, Calamitas , the two final bosses of Calamity. It is up to you which order they are fought in; it is often helpful to defeat the easier one first so that its drops can be used on the one you struggle with more. The Exo Box is heavily recommended for the Supreme Witch, Calami

name: Endgame
desc: Defeating the Exo Mechs and Supreme Witch, Calamitas allows you to combine Exo Prisms , Ashes of Annihilation , and Auric Bars into Shadowspec Bars . These are used to craft Demonshade armor and the developer items . Finally, you can challenge the Boss Rush event and the Primordial Wyrm boss using these new items.
